user.title: Thermoplan
user.description: Thermoplan is set up and managed in the sidebar. After finishing, open [Thermoplan]({url}) to add rooms, profiles, schedules and settings.

init.title: Thermoplan
init.description: All settings are in the Thermoplan sidebar: [Open Thermoplan]({url})

hold.name: Hold temperature
hold.description: Hold rooms at a fixed temperature, or raise them by an offset, for a while. Give either a temperature or an offset.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names. Leave empty for every room.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Raise (+) or lower (-) the planned target.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Raise rooms by the boost offset for a while (defaults come from the settings).

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names. Leave empty for every room.

cancel_hold.name: Cancel hold
cancel_hold.description: End a hold or boost early.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names. Leave empty for every room.

set_away.name: Set away
set_away.description: Switch heating to the away behavior until a date or for a number of days. 0 days ends it.

until.name: Until
until.description: Heating resumes on this date at the configured time.

missing_thermostat.title: Thermoplan: thermostat of {room} not found
missing_thermostat.description:
The thermostat `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). The room is not controlled until this is fixed.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_window_sensor.title: Thermoplan: window sensor of {room} not found
missing_window_sensor.description:
The window sensor `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Open windows are not detected.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_occupancy.title: Thermoplan: occupancy sensor of {room} not found
missing_occupancy.description:
The occupancy sensor `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Occupancy is ignored.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_real_thermostat.title: Thermoplan: real thermostat of {room} not found
missing_real_thermostat.description:
The real thermostat `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Its valve and heating state are not read.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_temp_sensor.title: Thermoplan: external temperature sensor of {room} not found
missing_temp_sensor.description:
The external temperature sensor `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). The thermostat readings are used instead.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_room_outdoor_sensor.title: Thermoplan: outdoor sensor of the room cutoff of {room} not found
missing_room_outdoor_sensor.description:
The outdoor sensor of the room cutoff `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). The weather entity is used instead, if set.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_room_weather.title: Thermoplan: weather entity of the room cutoff of {room} not found
missing_room_weather.description:
The weather entity of the room cutoff `{entity}` configured for the room **{room}** no longer exists (renamed or deleted). It cannot be used as a fallback.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_person.title: Thermoplan: person for presence rules not found
missing_person.description:
The person for presence rules `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Presence rules do not switch profiles.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_outdoor_sensor.title: Thermoplan: outdoor sensor of the outdoor cutoff not found
missing_outdoor_sensor.description:
The outdoor sensor of the outdoor cutoff `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). The weather entity is used instead, if set.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_weather.title: Thermoplan: weather entity of the outdoor cutoff not found
missing_weather.description:
The weather entity of the outdoor cutoff `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). It cannot be used as a fallback.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_workday.title: Thermoplan: workday sensor not found
missing_workday.description:
The workday sensor `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Free days are not detected from it.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_holiday.title: Thermoplan: holiday sensor not found
missing_holiday.description:
The holiday sensor `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Holidays are not detected from it.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_free_calendar.title: Thermoplan: free day calendar not found
missing_free_calendar.description:
The free day calendar `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Free days are not detected from it.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_calendar_away.title: Thermoplan: away calendar not found
missing_calendar_away.description:
The away calendar `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). Away periods are not detected from it.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.

missing_forecast.title: Thermoplan: weather forecast entity not found
missing_forecast.description:
The weather forecast entity `{entity}` in the Thermoplan settings no longer exists (renamed or deleted). The forecast cutoff does not work.

Open [Thermoplan](/thermoplan) and choose the new entity, or switch the feature off. This message disappears by itself once the entity exists again.
